statement: A preservation guard must validate the substance of a record, not just its title: deleting an entire withdrawal explanation while retaining its heading must fail. A digest of the normalized immutable explanation can preserve the claim, finding, withdrawn scope and republication condition across rendering formats while allowing a separate status field to evolve. Removing an artifact also requires auditing executable consumers, not just their tests; a green historical fixture does not prove the real harness still runs. When a preregistered harness cannot operate after removal, explicitly retire the current-checkout invocation and name a supported frozen revision rather than skipping its binding checks.
